title: Dyna-2: General Purpose Physical Agents with Hour-Long Autonomy — Jason Ma, Dyna Robotics
description: Our first robotics pod with Dyna’s Chief Scientist on their big bet on World Action Models & the Next Frontier of Physical AI
summary: Watch along AIE NYC and join us at AIE CODE in SF next month! This episode includes a live demo of the Taku robot that is best enjoyed on YouTube .
takeaways: World Action Models: Inputs, Outputs, and Visual Reasoning Vibhu [00:01:17]: I wanna prompt this question a bit.
Diffusion Transformers, Flow Matching, and Smooth Actions Vibhu [00:03:08]: You put out a good blog post around your model.

Last month, Dyna made waves by announcing Dyna-2 , a world-action model pre-trained on one million hours of human video, claiming several new scaling laws on human data across four orders of magnitude .
